comments.value:
1. Join a performance gated instance without the role permission to bypass avatar performance gating.

2. Use VRChat Home to change into a Very Poor avatar. You'll receive a "Your Avatar is Hidden" notification.

3. Use VRChat Home to change your fallback avatar to something else. (Step 6.)

4. Click "Change to your current fallback avatar" in the notification.

You'll be changed to your previous fallback avatar (step 4), not your current one (step 6).

details:
Since July 18, 2026, it's not possible to change fallback avatars live.

Related to: https://feedback.vrchat.com/bug-reports/p/change-into-avatar-from-vrchat-home-has-no-effect-in-vrchat-app-without-an-app-r

Steps to reproduce I've attempted:

1. Have two Good rated private avatars on all platforms.

2. Use VRChat SDK - Avatars 3.8.2 to set fallback tags on both avatars (or insert some data into avatar tags/categories in later SDK versions to avoid an API error).

3. Launch VRChat. Have a second client or a friend observe your fallback with "Use Impostor as Fallback" setting disabled - make sure the second user sees your fallback.

4. Navigate to [WubTheCaptain's Rusk](https://vrchat.com/home/avatar/avtr_8a33bffc-c9dd-45a5-a18e-55a18a31c0ef) (`avtr_8a33bffc-c9dd-45a5-a18e-55a18a31c0ef`) by WubTheCaptain on the VRChat Home website. Click "Use as Fallback".

7. Observe a message appears on the website indicating success, but nothing happens in the VRChat client app - no popup for you, and the other user won't see a change.

6. Navigate to [Rusk （Optimized NonToon）](https://vrchat.com/home/avatar/avtr_eea2d29c-b0f1-47a4-9089-9fddffc911af) (`avtr_eea2d29c-b0f1-47a4-9089-9fddffc911af`) by WubTheCaptain on the VRChat Home website. Click "Use as Fallback".

7. Observe a message appears on the website indicating success, but nothing happens in the VRChat client app - no popup for you, and the other user won't see a change.

Expected result: Fallback avatar changes, you get a popup message in the VRChat client your fallback avatar has been changed.

Actual result: The website gives a popup indicating fallback avatar was changed, but nothing happens in the VRChat client.

Additional info: There was formerly a "Restart to See Your New Fallback Avatar!" message on VRChat Home website on July 23-24, 2026. That message is now gone, but I think it should be added back for now. Only the "Change Into Avatar" button was fixed on July 24th.
title: Use as Fallback from VRChat Home has no effect in VRChat app without an app restart
